protocol.H1: >=2 B seeds second action share >=.05; median B-A return >0; median B DD<=A; median B stress return>=0
protocol.H2: Every B seed under both costs beats paired C and best fixed return, DD<=C and that best fixed reference

arms.C: B with seven market inputs zeroed

protocol.prefix_checks: raw and A/B/C transformed training prefix equal full-through-2024 prefix
protocol.selection: No tuning, no selected seed, no 2025 evaluation, no promotion
protocol.stress: commission, slippage and spread multiplier doubled; no stress retraining

limitations: 2024 validation and 2025 history have previously been viewed; neither is sealed blind evidence.
5038 training decisions repeated ~26 times per seed are not 131072 independent market samples.
HistData gaps include closures/unknown missing observations; no invented bars or forward fill.
Quotes are historical paired boundaries, not current executable broker quotes. Quote TTL is 120 seconds.
No financing/overnight costs, real depth, latency, partial fills or broker specifications modeled.
Only 3 seeds, 1 training year and 1 validation year; no statistical significance or forward profit claim.
C retains endogenous account state, which can indirectly encode past price moves; it is not an information-free policy.
All execution is simulated; no account integration or model promotion authorized.

numeric_audit.arithmetic: Python f64, row-order math.fsum + bias, math.tanh, first argmax
